definition: Geneware-modified bone and cartilage designed to flex rather than fracture under impact, giving the recipient a subtly inhuman range of motion. Recognizable to trained eyes by the fluid, jointless quality of movement. Popular in close-quarters combat and infiltration work.
origin: Helix Biosystems product terminology, adopted as street slang
usage: Combat specialists, infiltrators, and wealthy Tier 3-4 clients; Tier 1-2 access it through unlicensed chop shops
example: The way she moved through that vent shaft — no normal person bends like that. She's running soft architecture, probably full torso.
